summary: Highlands REIT filed an 8-K disclosing an unsolicited mini-tender offer by MacKenzie Capital Management to purchase its common stock at $0.04 per share, minus a $25 transfer fee. The board unanimously recommends rejection, citing the price as below long-term value and that the fee may materially reduce proceeds. The offeror has not filed a Schedule TO with the SEC. No deal terms or advisors are named. Risk-arb: shareholders should monitor SEC compliance and consider litigation or regulatory challenges to the low-ball bid.
